1: ## 1. Shared Types and TransactionStatus Component
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Create `dapp/types/transaction.ts` exporting the `TransactionState` union type and `DocumentRecord` interface
4: - [x] 1.2 Create `dapp/components/TransactionStatus.tsx` — idle renders null, in-progress states render Loader2 spinner with contextual text, success renders CheckCircle2 with optional txHash, error renders AlertCircle with message, rejected renders XCircle with fixed text
5: - [x] 1.3 Write unit tests for `TransactionStatus` covering all 8 state variants
6: 
7: ## 2. useDocumentRegistry Hook
8: 
9: - [x] 2.1 Create `dapp/hooks/useDocumentRegistry.ts` skeleton: initialise ethers.js v6 `Contract` from `MetaMaskContext` signer, expose `{ state, txHash, error, result }`
10: - [x] 2.2 Implement `storeDocument(file: File)`: SHA-256 via Web Crypto API → `isDocumentStored` pre-check → `estimateGas` → `signMessage` → `sendTransaction` → `waitForTransaction` — transitioning `state` at each step
11: - [x] 2.3 Implement error normalisation: code 4001 → `rejected`; all others → `error` with human-readable string
12: - [x] 2.4 Implement `verifyDocument(hash: string)`: validate bytes32 format → `contract.verifyDocument.staticCall(hash)` → set `result.isAuthentic` on success
13: - [x] 2.5 Implement `getDocument(hash: string)`: call `contract.getDocument(hash)` → return typed `DocumentRecord`, throw normalised error if not found
14: - [x] 2.6 Implement `getPage(page: number, pageSize: number)`: fetch count → derive index range → call `getDocumentHashByIndex` for each index → call `getDocument` for each hash → return `DocumentRecord[]`
15: - [x] 2.7 Mark `dapp/hooks/useContract.ts` as `@deprecated` in JSDoc comment, noting migration path to `useDocumentRegistry`
16: 
17: ## 3. DocumentUploader Component
18: 
19: - [x] 3.1 Implement dropzone area (drag & drop + "Select File" button) with client-side format validation (PDF, DOCX, TXT) and size validation (≤ 10 MB)
20: - [x] 3.2 Wire file selection to `useDocumentRegistry().storeDocument(file)` — the hook drives state
21: - [x] 3.3 Render `<TransactionStatus state={state} txHash={txHash} error={error} />` below the form
22: - [x] 3.4 Disable submit button during any non-idle, non-success, non-error, non-rejected state
23: - [x] 3.5 Display the truncated hash preview (`0x1234…5678`) after validation completes
24: 
25: ## 4. DocumentVerifier Component
26: 
27: - [x] 4.1 Implement dual input: file upload (auto-computes hash) and manual text field for `0x`-prefixed bytes32
28: - [x] 4.2 Add inline validation message for invalid hash format; disable verify button when invalid
29: - [x] 4.3 Wire "Verify" button to `useDocumentRegistry().verifyDocument(hash)`
30: - [x] 4.4 Render `<TransactionStatus state={state} error={error} />` for in-progress / error / rejected states
31: - [x] 4.5 On `success`, render authenticity badge: green "Document Authentic ✓" if `result.isAuthentic`, red "Invalid Signature ✗" if false — include signer address and timestamp from `getDocument`
32: 
33: ## 5. DocumentExplorer Component
34: 
35: - [x] 5.1 On component mount, call `useDocumentRegistry().getPage(0, 10)`
36: - [x] 5.2 Render 10-row skeleton table while `state` is `"validating"`
37: - [x] 5.3 Render paginated document rows on `success`: truncated hash (`font-mono`), truncated signer, formatted timestamp; show "Page X of Y" and Prev/Next controls
38: - [x] 5.4 Render empty state "No documents registered yet" when `getDocumentCount` returns 0
39: - [x] 5.5 On `error`, render error message + "Retry" button that re-invokes `getPage` with the current page number
40: - [x] 5.6 On row click, call `getDocument(hash)` and show detail panel: full hash, full signer, formatted timestamp, raw signature hex; close button dismisses panel
